source_kind: derived aggregate over retained USDA FSIS active MPI directory evidence
ownership: USDA FSIS publishes source fields; this publisher owns only the governed aggregate transformation.
allowed_use: bounded source activity and active-grant counts
prohibited_use: publishing names, other names, addresses, phones, coordinates, geometry, establishment identifiers, record identifiers, or raw records
claiming all food businesses, all inspected businesses, current operations beyond source directory membership, physical public access, current hours, ownership, or nationwide completeness
joining ZIP5 and ZIP4 or treating Census ZCTA membership as USPS validity
retention: Retain immutable aggregate releases with exact dependency pins.
redistribution: Governed aggregates only with USDA FSIS attribution, source date, provenance, and limitations.
personal_data_handling: Aggregate counts only; all record-level names, addresses, phones, identifiers, and coordinates are prohibited.
privacy_warning: No names, contact details, addresses, coordinates, geometry, identifiers, or individual records may be exported.
attribution: Source: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection Directory and Establishment Demographic Data.
